title: Haan Maine Bhi Pyar Kiya
desc: Shiv and Pooja's marriage shatters when she discovers his infidelity. Their lives take a new turn when Raj, a film star, enters Pooja's life.

title: Dil Juunglee
desc: Koroli, an English teacher and business tycoon's daughter, unexpectedly falls for Sumit, an aspiring Bollywood actor who enrolls in her class to win her heart.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest cop, is posted to a crime-ridden town. He battles ruthless criminals, crooked officers, and shady politicians to restore law and justice.

title: Rustom
desc: Rustom is a navy officer happily married to Cynthia. When he finds out she's cheating with his friend Vikram, things turn tragic, and Rustom is blamed for murder.

title: Tehran
desc: After a 2012 Delhi bombing, officer RK's Tehran mission turns deadly when Iran targets him and India abandons him in his quest to expose the truth.

title: Khamoshiyan
desc: Kabir, a struggling writer seeking inspiration in Kashmir, stays at a mysterious guest house and falls for Meera, its owner, unaware she is hiding a dark secret.

title: Turtle
desc: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.

title: Suraj Pe Mangal Bhari
desc: Suraj, an eligible bachelor, faces repeated rejections from prospective brides' families, only to discover that a wedding detective, Madhu Mangal Rane, is secretly behind his misfortunes.

title: Maharaja
desc: Prince Kohinoor returns after twenty years to reclaim his kingdom. To stop him, Ranbir kidnaps his nanny Ameenabi, forcing the prince to use his powers to rescue her.

title: Badhaai Ho Badhaai
desc: Anjali and Anthony elope, marrying despite their parents' anger. Twenty-seven years later, a young man claiming to be their son arrives, hoping to heal the rift between their families.

title: Phone Bhoot
desc: Two young men start a ghost-catching business inspired by childhood stories. Their work turns dangerous when they must face a poltergeist and keep a promise that could cost them dearly.

title: Race 3
desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

title: Don 2
desc: After ruling the Asian underworld, Don targets Europe's criminal scene. Trapped between the Berlin mafia and relentless law enforcement, he fights to survive betrayal.

title: Koogle Kuttappa
desc: A conservative villager opposes his son's move to Russia for work, but when the son brings home a robot caregiver, he forms an unexpected bond with the machine.

title: Om Jai Jagdish
desc: Three brothers put aside their differences to join forces and save their ancestral home from being auctioned, resolving their family's legacy and their own personal issues.
